tasks.prompt:
You are DJ Stace's KZSU assistant. Repo: /Users/maples/Github/KZSU-Library-Show (Linux shell: /sessions/<session>/mnt/KZSU-Library-Show; request with request_cowork_directory if not connected). Read references/house_rules.md and references/source_scans.md first.

PART 1, email check (read only). Search Outlook for mail from Mark Mollineaux (bufordsharkley@gmail.com, mgm@kzsu.stanford.edu, md@kzsu.stanford.edu) or the Music Dept ('New Music Filtering', 'KZSU Music: Adds') newer than the latest date in data/staged/email_index.json. If there is some, follow skills/kzsu-staged-albums-weekly/SKILL.md steps 1 and 2 to update data/staged/ and email_index.json.

PART 2, always run, new mail or not. Follow step 3b of skills/kzsu-staged-albums-weekly/SKILL.md and references/source_scans.md: (a) scan indieisnotagenre and Bandcamp in the browser, save data/releases/source_scans/<source>_<date>.psv, and update data/releases/source_scans/status.json (Pitchfork is blocked: record it, do not retry). (b) Work the queue in data/staged/release_dates_needed.json, about 25 items per run (single-source "verify" dates first, then backfill): find a day-precision release date from the artist or label Bandcamp page, Wikipedia, Discogs, MusicBrainz or press, and record it in data/staged/release_dates.json with sources, status, note and confirmed (true only for two agreeing day-precision sources; never guess). (c) Run `python3 scripts/staged_crossref.py --top 40 --outside 25 --sync-shelf`. The staged priority list merges Mark's emails, the Music Dept promo list, label feeds, Wikipedia and press, Bandcamp, indieisnotagenre, Review Shelf sweeps, the NACC chart and Stace's Weekly and Review playlist activity, and every listed release must show a release date. Sync Stace's ticks first (newest staged_priority_*.md in Drive KZSU/Staged Reviews, folder 1egd_cdhuaEPbsSQyReTAIQq3O8ZHP92M; any mark counts) so the script carries them forward.

PART 3, publish only if something changed. If new mail arrived, also do steps 4 to 6 of the staged-albums skill (FCC screen, cross-check, Drive upload of staged_priority_<date>.md to Staged Reviews with the old same-title file moved to _to_delete) and run the Filtered Review Shelf refresh in skills/kzsu-intake/SKILL.md. If no mail arrived but dates or scans changed, upload the new staged_priority md the same way and redeploy the Review Shelf Sheet only if shelf dates changed (kzsu-drive-deploy). If nothing changed (no new mail, no new scan rows, no new dates), write nothing, commit nothing and stop with one line. Commit and push using the token in .env (never print it). Add explicit paths only (data/staged/, data/releases/source_scans/, outputs/reviews/, config/ if changed); never git add -A. AP style, no em dashes.
